intro: Bedok North Springs is an HDB project in Bedok. Our project file carries a third-party completion estimate, but this entry is not officially confirmed: the HDB key date has not been verified, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month. Unit counts and that estimated month are therefore left out of the facts below. If you are an owner approaching handover, use your HDB key-appointment letter and your approved plan as the source of truth. We will not publish a tracker month as if HDB had issued it. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Bedok North Springs renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Bedok North Springs interior
sections.text:
Bedok is a large, mature eastern town. Owners who are close to keys here usually want the first fit-out to work as a long-stay home: a kitchen that can take daily cooking, bedrooms with proper wardrobes, and a living room that is not a dump of loose cabinets. The joinery that typically does that job is fitted kitchen cabinetry with a tall pantry or fridge run, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall. Maison specifies this as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will design from your approved HDB plan only. We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies or a typical Bedok North Springs layout.

Chai Chee Green, Bayshore Oasis and Bayshore Sails are other Bedok pages in this batch. The two Bayshore projects were launched in November 2026 and are at a very different stage; do not treat their launch information as a key date for Bedok North Springs. We will not invent walking times to Bedok town, to the east coast, or to any MRT station. Check your own block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking.

After keys, the usual HDB order is defects inspection, a measured survey, the HDB renovation permit, and only then fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and, if you have it, the key letter. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.a: Not in our project file. This project is not officially confirmed, so unit counts and tracker dates have been left blank. If you have an HDB key-appointment letter, use that.

faq.q: Do you have the Bedok North Springs floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved HDB unit plan.

faq.q: Do I need an HDB renovation permit?
faq.a: Yes, for the usual HDB renovation works. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the permit with a registered contractor before carpentry is fabricated.
Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
